issues.jp_before: 熱[ねつ]{が|ga-existence}ある時[とき]{は|wa-topic}お風呂[ふろ]{に|ni-destination}入[はい]っ{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: お風呂に入る is the catalog's ni-target (入る), not a destination (へ is not natural here).

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}うそ{を|o-object}つい{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: The person lied to is a recipient, not a target of contact.

issues.jp_before: 親[おや]{に|ni-target}心配[しんぱい]{を|o-object}かけ{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: 親に心配をかける marks the person affected (recipient), not contact.

issues.jp_before: ここ{に|ni-location}車[くるま]{を|o-object}止[と]め{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: ni-location is for existence (ある・いる・住む); here に marks where the car is put.

issues.jp_before: 道[みち]{に|ni-location}ごみ{を|o-object}捨[す]て{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: Same as above: placement point of 捨てる, not existence.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{が|ga-subject}話[はな]し{て|te-sequence}いる時[とき]{に|ni-time}物[もの]{を|o-object}食[た]べ{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: The て of ている was marked as te-sequence (it is not a sequence connective); が inside the 時 clause is a sub-clause subject and の is equally possible.
issues.action: Removed the ている slot, set が/の with ga-sub-clause, adjusted f from 4 to 3.

issues.jp_before: 一日中[いちにちじゅう]、雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]っ{ては|te-wa}止[や]み、降[ふ]っ{ては|te-wa}止[や]み{を|o-object}繰[く]り返[かえ]していました。
issues.problem: 降っては止み、降っては止みを繰り返す is awkward (を after a repeated ては phrase; 降ったり止んだりを繰り返す is the natural form).
issues.action: Rewrote as 雨が降っては止み、止んでは降る一日でした with matching English.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{に|ni-time}コーヒー{を|o-object}飲[の]ん{では|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 'drink alcohol before driving' item; the file is dominated by the same てはいけません frame.
issues.action: Replaced with この水は飲んではだめですよ (てはだめ variant).

issues.jp_before: 食事[しょくじ]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{に|ni-time}お菓子[かし]{を|o-object}食[た]べ{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate frame (Xの前に…てはいけません) of another item; low variety.
issues.action: Replaced with そんなに無理をしては病気になりますよ (ては + bad result), distractors ても/と/ば (て avoided: 無理をして病気になる would fit the meaning).

issues.jp_before: 友[とも]だち{の|no-possessive}悪口[わるぐち]{を|o-object}言[い]っ{ては|te-wa}いけません。
issues.problem: lv 2 is too high; 悪口 is around N3.
